messages:
Priya Shah: Quick pass request — Halo integrations solution sheet (for marketplace tile + partner site). Can we check logo lockups, badge wording, and whether the partner quote is ok to include? Uploaded draft here: https://drive.redwood/hub/halo-solution-sheet-v2.pdf

Matt Gomez: grabbing now. Will check artboard sizes and safe zones. Any size constraints from marketplaces?

Priya Shah: marketplace wants 1200x627 for the tile, and a square logo 200x200. Halo prefers their horizontal logo where space allows.

Matt Gomez: ok. I see the horizontal logo overlaps the CTA area in mobile crop. Suggest switching to stacked mark for mobile tile. Will push a quick mock. :iphone:

Olivia Tran: on the quote — Halo provided this line: "Redwood made inference predictable at scale for us". Marketing wants to add attribution (title + company). Do we have approval to publish with that exact wording?

Simon Lee: tagging LegalBot for clearance. LegalBot: please advise if that quote needs a signed asset release or if the partner email thread suffices.

LegalBot: Quick check: partner-provided testimonial language requires a Partner Quote Release signed by an authorized Halo rep. Email chain qualifies only if the rep explicitly says "approve quote for public use". If not present, please get a signed PDF.

Priya Shah: Got it — Kate, can you loop Halo for a signed release? If they approve wording as-is, we can proceed. If they want changes, we may need edit.

Kate Morales: on it — I’ll reach out to contact@halo.io and request the signed release and confirm horizontal vs stacked logo use. ETA 2 hours.

Matt Gomez: mock uploaded: `files/halo_tile_mobile_v1.png`. Using stacked mark for mobile, horizontal for desktop. Also included a 200x200 square crop for marketplace. Notes in the file: padding 16px, no drop shadows.

Priya Shah: thanks matt. Olivia — once Legal clears, can you finalize the one-liner and microcopy for the marketplace tile (headline + 2-line body)? Need final by EOD for the marketplace intake.

Olivia Tran: yes — will draft and post here. Draft headline: "Production LLMs with predictable cost" body: "Halo and Redwood reduced inference latency by 3x while cutting per-token costs." Will refine after legal/quote.

Simon Lee: minor legal flag on performance claims — if we keep numbers, we need source/benchmark or change to "reduced latency and cost". Avoid specific multipliers unless verified.

Priya Shah: good catch. Olivia — please remove the "3x" unless Halo provides the benchmark doc.

Olivia Tran: updated copy: "Production LLMs with predictable cost" 

body: "Halo and Redwood reduced inference latency and improved unit economics for production workloads." Posting final draft in 10.

Kate Morales: Halo replied: they approved quote text and signed the release (attached: halo-quote-release.pdf). Also asked we prefer horizontal lockup on partner site but stacked in marketplace — ok to proceed.

Matt Gomez: final assets uploaded: `files/halo_tile_desktop.png`, `files/halo_tile_mobile.png`, `files/halo_logos.zip` (SVG + PNG, 200px/400px). All have correct padding and color profiles.

Priya Shah: perfect. Next steps: Olivia, finalize intake form and submit to marketplace. Matt, move art to CDN with correct filenames. LegalBot, thanks for the quick guidance.

LegalBot: noted. Keep record of signed release in /legal/partner-releases/halo-1902345699.pdf.

Priya Shah: closing thread — will post final proof once marketplace ingestion returns a manifest. :white_check_mark:
